title: The lower integer layer and a local generator of its quotient
statement: Let X have compact opens stable under binary intersection, and let ι:K→C be a monomorphism of abelian sheaves with C isomorphic to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Suppose K is generated by a finite coproduct of constant integer extensions by zero on compact opens [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Fix integer identifications e_x of the stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] of C, and b in N, and suppose the image of e_x ι_x is aZ with 0≤a≤b+1 at every point. Then there exist a monomorphism l:L→K, a finite compact-open generating coproduct for L, and the bound 0≤a≤b for the images of e_x ι_x l_x. There are compact opens V⊆U and q:j_U!Z→coker l. The cokernel stalk is zero at every point in V or outside U, and q_x is an isomorphism at every point in U minus V. No short complex or exact sequence is asserted.

proof.text: Identify C with the constant integer sheaf. The finite compact-open generating maps become locally constant integer sections. Partition each compact open into finitely many compact clopen pieces on which its value is constant, discard zero values, and reverse negative signs. Adjoin every nonempty finite intersection with its gcd section, constructed by Bezout. Intersections are compact by hqc; added sections lie in the old image. The gcd of the labels active at any point is now an active label. The arbitrary stalk coordinates differ from canonical coordinates by sign, so the bound a ≤ b+1 holds canonically too. Discard labels above b+1; an active gcd label remains at every nonzero stalk, hence the retained family still generates K.

Define L as the image in K of the finite coproduct of retained sections with label at most b. The image factorization gives a monomorphism l and an epimorphism from this finite compact-open coproduct to L. At any point, its image is generated by the active low labels, and therefore has generator at most b when nonzero, or zero if none is active. Let U be the union of retained opens and V the union of low-label opens. These finite unions are compact and V is contained in U. Gcd closure makes the stalks of L and K equal on V; outside U both vanish. Exactness of the abelian stalk functor shows coker l has zero stalks there.

Let W be the union of opens labelled b+1. Their constant b+1 sections agree in K, since they have identical images under its monomorphism to C. Their quotient classes glue on W. Glue that section to zero on V; the quotient restricts to zero on V, so they agree on W intersect V. As U=W union V, this produces a quotient section on U. Constant-sheaf and extension-by-zero adjunctions yield q:j_U!Z→coker l. At x in U minus V the stalk K_x has positive generator b+1 and L_x=0, so q_x sends 1 to that generator and is an isomorphism. Empty families and empty top layers give respectively U=V empty and U=V.

theorem constantSubsheaf_lower_layer_generator
    (X : TopCat.{u})
    (hqc : ∀ U V : Opens X, IsCompact (U : Set X) → IsCompact (V : Set X) →
      IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : Opens X) : Set X))
    (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X)
    (ι : K ⟶ C)
    [Mono ι]
    (hC : Nonempty (C ≅
      (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
    (hgen : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X)
      (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact ((U i : Opens X) : Set X)),
      ∃ g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K, Epi g)
    (e : ∀ x : X, TopCat.Presheaf.stalk C.obj x ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))
    (b : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ x : X, ∃ a : ℕ, a ≤ b + 1 ∧
      Set.range (fun t : ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk K.obj x) ↦
        (e x).hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map ι.hom t)) =
      Set.range (fun z : ULift.{u} ℤ ↦ (a : ℤ) • z)) :
    ∃ (L : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (l : L ⟶ K), Mono l ∧
      (∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X)
      (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact ((U i : Opens X) : Set X)),
      ∃ g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ L, Epi g) ∧
      (∀ x : X, ∃ a : ℕ, a ≤ b ∧
      Set.range (fun t : ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.obj x) ↦
        (e x).hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (l ≫ ι).hom t)) =
      Set.range (fun z : ULift.{u} ℤ ↦ (a : ℤ) • z)) ∧
      ∃ (U V : Opens X), IsCompact (U : Set X) ∧ IsCompact (V : Set X) ∧ V ≤ U ∧
        ∃ q : (abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⟶ cokernel l,
          (∀ x : X, x ∈ V ∨ x ∉ U →
            IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (cokernel l).obj x)) ∧
          (∀ x : X, x ∈ U → x ∉ V →
            IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map q.hom))
